elements.text: The water network for Southeast Asia
A premium, zero-emission water layer — in your app, on your wallet, with your captains.
Privileged & Confidential. Distribution without consent is strictly prohibited.
The Three C's of Scalable Water Transportation

90% lower energy cost.
Autonomy removes labor cost.

No noise. No fumes. 
No sea sickness.

App integration.
Available from any marina.
Southeast Asia is the most water-fragmented major region
premium water corridors, sourced from real demand today
premium sea-transfer spend already moving on these lanes, per year
Grab already owns the demand in every coastal megacity; the water leg books door-to-door with a GrabCar at each pier.
vessels at full network maturity across 375+ mapped corridors
marine-transfer TAM (induced market) · model band $3.7–13.2B, mid $7.3B

A new multi-billion-dollar vertical in Southeast Asia
Read it bottom-up: the fare a Navier boat collects today, the market a faster product unlocks — then the whole journey a super-app monetizes around every crossing.
SOM — Navier fare, full SEA network, today's trips, 10% capture
SAM — faster, quieter boats grow the market; 25% capture at maturity
TAM — the entire induced marine-transfer market (≈ 4× SAM; band $3.7–13.2B)
Journey GMV — add food + stays + experiences to every crossing (≈ 3× TAM)
Grab platform revenue on Navier — 18% × Navier-corridor Journey GMV (ceiling $3.9B on full journey GMV)
You bring the demand. We operate the water.

▸  Grab — demand, the app, the wallet and the brand.
▸  Navier — vessels, crew, charging, maintenance and the operating playbook — a turnkey water service.
▸  Together — a co-branded premium water tier backed by strong vessel financing models.

1.  Working session — walk through the presentation and Navier atlas. 
2.  Vessel demo — arrange a Navier experience in Asia or US
3.  Pilot scope — define one corridor, berths and timeline for a real on-water pilot.
